mapper.sql: u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and (u.user_type = '00' or u.user_type is null or u.user_type = '') and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' left join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and (r.role_key = 'admin' or m.perms = 'nad:conversation:participate') )
mapper.select: select coalesce(nullif(nick_name, ''), user_name) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
select exists(select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and )
select exists(select 1 from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and user_type = '10')
select u.user_id from sys_user u where order by coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) limit #{limit}

select user_id as userId, coalesce(nullif(nick_name, ''), user_name) as name, email, avatar from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and (user_type = '00' or user_type is null or user_type = '') order by nick_name, user_name
